# Reviewed material 8-K fixtures

Official SEC EDGAR documents retrieved and reverified on 2026-09-23. UTF-8 source-text hashes pin each reviewed document. CI reads only these local fixtures; no live SEC dependency.

The submissions fixtures retain recent 8-K metadata from 2025-01-01 and selected older documents. Unreviewed candidate filings require only index metadata and remain in the review queue. Thirteen source documents support twelve observations / eleven grouped events; two source documents are reviewed exclusions. The three-company selection is not a comprehensive event archive.

Descriptions use fixed Swedish templates and exact source-backed parameters. Numeric values are deterministic conversions of reviewed numeric text with explicit units, scale and qualifiers. No LLM or free-form summary generation runs in ingestion or presentation. The source review registry stores item scope, immutable identity, related prior observation and supporting passages.

Special cases: NVIDIA agreement/guarantee/FD items form one event; SOFI new 2029 notes and exchanges of 2026 notes are distinct transactions within one filing. The SOFI amendment updates only the exchange observation. CrowdStrike restructuring is separate from its co-filed Item 2.02 disclosure; the July 2024 outage explicitly was not a cyberattack. No real Item 1.05 cybersecurity or Item 2.06 impairment example was found in the inspected recent pilot indexes. Tests cover those candidate codes synthetically.
